leftEvidence.title: The crowds respond to Jesus’ authority

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Matthew reports that Jesus finishes the sayings and the crowds are astonished.
points.right: Jesus comes down from the mountain with crowds following, and a leper asks to be cleansed if Jesus wills.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: They distinguish his teaching authority from that of their scribes.
points.right: Jesus touches and cleanses him, then directs him to the priest and Moses’ commanded gift.

payload.posture: Crowds respond to Jesus’ teaching, then follow as a leper approaches Jesus’ will and power.

rightEvidence.title: Jesus descends and a leper approaches

payload.tension: Astonishment is not the same response as the leper’s appeal and obedience.
payload.title: Authority heard and authority encountered
